compatibility_policy.reader_policy: accept only explicitly registered schema identifiers and versions

cuda_disposition.rationale: The audited legacy tree has no maintained CUDA source, execution driver, or result-bearing CUDA test. Backend name fragments in generated-code helpers do not establish a release-scope capability.

native_artifacts.rationale: A self-contained typed-graph C compiler removes shared mutable package-directory objects and legacy BitString allocation helpers.
Generated C is self-contained and requires no shipped private header.
Typed fixed-width generation emits only the helpers required by the selected graph and records unsupported widths explicitly.
The v5 native artifact has no installed header ABI; compilation is an optional driver operation.

mixed_module_surfaces.rationale: Small primitive-oriented serialization, source compilation, file-writing, compilation, and execution operations replace one mutable catch-all class surface; M10.10 transformation ownership remains unchanged.
Canonical bytes, safe explicit writes, isolated execution, and semantic parity replace stdout formatting and current-directory side effects; M10.10 evidence in the same file remains closed.

Bounded semantic parity and isolated compiler-driver tests replace pytest timing wrappers around shared-directory native builds and NumPy layouts. Scalar and avalanche benchmarks in the mixed file retain their achieved owners.

diagram_audit.rationale: The backend-neutral IR already preserves typed selections, rounds, annotations, routed ASCII connectors, deterministic TikZ, escaping, and optional isolated PDF rendering. M10.15 adds closure evidence only for genuine gaps.
